headline: Trump faces scattered scandals: ballooning, Lake Ontario rename, DOJ overreach
summary: Voices scatter across multiple Trump controversies, from a Lake Ontario renaming stunt to DOJ overreach allegations, with critics mocking and alleging corruption while few defend him.
